description: Build a DMARC TXT record and the host to publish it at, from a policy and the addresses that should receive aggregate reports. Notes what the record does not cover yet. Computes from the arguments only; nothing is looked up or stored.

domain.description: The domain the record protects, like example.com. Used for the host name and the external reporting check.

policy.description: What receivers do with failing email. Start at none while you read reports.

strict_dkim.description: Require an exact DKIM domain match (adkim=s).

strict_spf.description: Require an exact SPF domain match (aspf=s).

subdomain_policy.description: A different policy for subdomains (sp=). Leave out to use the main policy.

name: generate_dmarc_record
title: Generate a DMARC record
